translation.name: Xchiʼdxyi cuubi dxiohs nin bieʼgaluuʼyi daada Jesucristu (El Nuevo Testamento en el zapoteco de Chichicapan y en español)

content: Chin guyuuꞌnehza Pahblu para Roma

Biaꞌhan dxyiꞌdxyi raꞌ ba xi dxyih choo nu laꞌn tuhbi barcu para choo nu Italia. Pahblu cun snuhn bwiinn nin ñieꞌw biahca raꞌ ba ntriehgu loh tuhbi capitahn nin biriaꞌhlah Juliu. Rnabwaꞌ ba tuhbi gaywaꞌh suldahdu, naa raꞌ ba tuhbi batayohn nin laa Augusto.
Ya bachicaꞌh nu laꞌn barcu xteenn Adramitiu nin guzee para Asia, ya zoozah nu laꞌn barcu tuhsi cun Aristarcu bwiinn guihdxyi Tesalónica xteenn naciohn Macedonia.
Ya chin barah gueꞌla badzihn nu pwertu xteenn guihdxyi Sidohn; riꞌchi bwiꞌhnn Juliu bwen duxa laꞌh Pahblu laasii basaaꞌn ba gwahguiaꞌha Pahblu cuun raꞌ xamihgu ba tin bayihdxyi ba laꞌh raꞌ ba.
Ya chin bariaꞌh nu Sidohn, bachidiiꞌdxi nu isla nin laa Chipre nin biaꞌhan xlahdu rabwehsa nu, pur bwih nin zuu hohra chi guriin zeeꞌhen zeeneeꞌhen barcu niꞌchin ayi chyu gwah lahda derehchu,
niꞌchin bachidiiꞌdxi nu gahxu cweeꞌ rwaaꞌ ñihsadoꞌ xteenn Cilicia cun Panfilia, ya seguihdu badzihn nu rwaaꞌ guihdxyi Mira xteenn Licia.
Riꞌchi biuuꞌnbwaꞌ capitahn xteenn raꞌ suldahdu tuhbi barcu nin zee nez guihdxyi Alejandria. Barcu chi guzee hasta Italia, chiꞌchi nnah raꞌ ba laꞌn barcu rii guzoo nu.

Ziahan dxyih guzahnee barcu laꞌhnu chiꞌlaaꞌdzi, ya trabahjw duxa badzihn nu rwaaꞌ isla Gnidu, laasii pur bwih duxa nin zuu loh ñihsadoꞌ nez hasta zoo nu, chiꞌchi bachidiiꞌdxi nu rwaaꞌ guihdxyi Salmohn, biahyinee barcu laꞌnu cweeꞌ isla nin laa Creta.
Ya loh trabahjw duxatiiꞌ riiꞌ, badzihnnee barcu laꞌhnu loh ñihsadoꞌ nez cweeꞌ isla Creta, chiꞌchiyi badzihn nu tuhbi hasta laa buenos pwertos, gahxugah guihdxyi Lasea.

Riꞌchi guhcataꞌh nu zirooꞌ chieempa laasii badzihn dxyih raꞌ nin rucwaaꞌhan raꞌ bwiinn Israel ziga loh bweꞌhw nahlda, nee zigala rulluꞌhn rriezgu sah raꞌ barcu loh ñihsadoꞌ loh bweꞌhw raꞌ chi, niꞌchin rahbi Pahblu loh raꞌ bwiinn:
―Xamihgu raꞌn, rahcabwaꞌn rulluꞌhn rriezgu, ñihchiloh carga xteenn barcu nee ayi niꞌchisidxiꞌh sino que pweda hasta nee xquelnabahan raꞌnuꞌh.

Per capitahn xteenn raꞌ suldahdu mahzi bwiꞌhnn cweenta ba xchiꞌdxyi nin naa xteenn ñiꞌh barcu cun neezaa laꞌh bwiinn nin rusazah barcu chi o sea capitahn xteenn barcu, ya dxiꞌdxyi raꞌ nin guñiꞌ Pahblu ayi gwachii stoꞌ raꞌ ban.

Ya pwertu chi ayi xi bwen ñiaꞌhan raꞌ ba loh bweꞌhw raꞌ nin rahca nahlda duxa, ya niꞌchin garaa raꞌ ba bwiꞌhnn raꞌ ba lligaaba mahs chaꞌyi gariaꞌh nu riiꞌ tin para guunn raꞌ ba jweersi guidiaꞌhan zuhnn raꞌ ba gahn gadzihn raꞌ ba guihdxyi Fenice tuhbi pwertu xteenn Creta tin riꞌchi ñutiꞌdxi raꞌ ba bweꞌhw nahlda.

Chiꞌchi guzoꞌbaloh tuhbi bwih biꞌtuꞌhn nez lahdu ñaaꞌ gueeta, niꞌchin bwiꞌhnn raꞌ ba lligaaba nastoꞌ raꞌ ba ayi ru xi rriezgu loh biahja chi, ya cun zee raꞌ ba loh ñihsadoꞌ gahxu cweeꞌ rwaaꞌ ñihsadoꞌ xteenn Creta,
per balaaquiꞌhnsi rahca zoozah nu loh ñihsadoꞌ chin guzohbaloh tuhbi bwih duxa nin laa Euroclidohn nin guluuꞌbiahchi duxa laꞌh barcu nin zoo nu laꞌn ñiꞌh.
Guzaꞌloh gooꞌballehxa bwih duxa chi laꞌh barcu ya coma ayi nuu xa ñidiꞌhnn nu cun bwih duxa chi mejor basaaꞌn nu zenee bwih chi laꞌh barcu.
Bachidiiꞌdxi nu cweeꞌ tuhbi isla biꞌtuꞌhn nin laa Claudia, ya trabahjw duxa bacaꞌh nu canua nin naa salvavida laꞌn barcu,

yaque guyaꞌloh bacaꞌh nu canua chi laꞌn barcu chiꞌchi bazuh raꞌ ba duꞌh gaduhbi tihxi barcu tin guhca chihpan tin ayi guibihyin. Ya ziga rdxyihbi raꞌ ba chechuu barcu chi loh yuhlli xteenn isla nin laa Sirte nin nuu loh ñihsadoꞌ, niꞌchin nin batehta raꞌ ba lahdxi rooꞌ nin caa yihca barcu chi, tin ziꞌchi zalliaꞌyiꞌhn guluuꞌnbwih bwih chi laꞌh barcu.
Ya chin barah gueꞌla, mahzi ru zuu bwih duxa chi neezaa mahziru cagariꞌh duxan laꞌh barcu chi loh nin zeezahan, chiꞌchi gucaꞌh raꞌ ba nuhn carga bazaꞌhla raꞌ ban loh ñihsadoꞌ.
Ya nin riohnna dxyih cun naa gahca nu bazaꞌhla nu garaa xtraxta barcu loh ñihsadoꞌ.
Chin laꞌpaaldaa dxyih guhca ñeꞌw loh gubihdxyi, nin dxih llaaꞌndxibaaꞌ ayi chyu rwaꞌha gueꞌla laasii pur bwih duxa nin zuu loh ñihsadoꞌ chi, niꞌchin bidiꞌhnn nu lligaaba zahchi nu.

Nee laasii naala xchih rooꞌ ayi chyu rahw, chiꞌchi gwazuꞌnchii Pahblu galaayi raꞌ xcompañehru ba ziga zeꞌ raꞌ ba laꞌn barcu chi rahbi ba: ―Xamihgu raꞌn, mahz chaꞌyi ñucaꞌdxiahga yuꞌbitu xchiꞌdxyiꞌhn, ayi ñariaꞌhan nu pwertu xteenn Creta, ya ziꞌchi ayi chyu ñizahca yaꞌdxyi riiꞌ.
Per nnah gulcwahchidxyii stoꞌ tu, ayi xi lligaaba guunn ru tu, laasii nin tuhbi nuꞌh ayi chyu gachi nicla laꞌh barcu ñihchiloh,
laasii nnagueꞌla baluuꞌyiloh tuhbi xanjla Dxiohs nin naa Xchiohsaꞌhn loon nee ruhnnzahn xtsiꞌn Ñiꞌh,
chiꞌchi nnah Ñiꞌh loon: “Ayi guidxyihbi luꞌh Pahblu laasii nahpaa chee luꞌh loh rrehyi César, ya pur yiꞌh niꞌchin nin zutaꞌh Dxiohs laꞌh garaa raꞌ nin zeꞌnee luꞌh laꞌn barcu loh guelguhchi.”
Niꞌchin nin cañiꞌn loh yuꞌbitu ayi guidxyihbi tu laasii naꞌh riachii stoꞌn xchiꞌdxyi Dxiohs niꞌchin nin naꞌpahn siguhra zizoꞌba xchiꞌdxyi Dxiohs ziga gunnah xaanjla Dxiohs loon.
Per zariaꞌcaa nuꞌh gahxu tuhbi isla.

Nee tuhbi gueꞌla yaque gudiiꞌdxi chiohpa xmahn nin zezahnee barcu laꞌhnu loh ñihsadoꞌ Adria nezii neziꞌchi pur bwih duxa chi, ya mahs garoolda gueꞌlan badiꞌhi raꞌ ndxiꞌhw raꞌ nin rusazah barcu cweenta laꞌbarcu zalliaaꞌh guilluhbi loh yuh,

chiꞌchi badiꞌxi raꞌ ba loh ñihsadoꞌ gu zalliaaꞌ cayaꞌdxyi guilluhbi barcu loh yuh llaaꞌn ñihsadoꞌ riꞌchi badiꞌxi raꞌ ba nuu zigachiꞌh galdabitsiꞌ bixoꞌpa metru, ya mahs delanta badiꞌxi raꞌ ba loh ñihsadoꞌ hasta llaaꞌn ñihsa za gahldaabigahdzi si metru laꞌh xbarcu raꞌ ba guilluhbi la loh yuh.
Ya pur nin bidxyihbi duxa raꞌ ba ñicaꞌnchii barcu yihca dxiah, bacaꞌh raꞌ ba tahpa dxiꞌba rooꞌ nin naa ziga ansuelu cweeꞌhen, ya rdxyihbi duxa raꞌ ba oquisiehra raꞌ ba dxiaꞌñihgah.

Ya seguihdu bwiꞌhnn raꞌ bwiinn nin rusazah barcu chi lligaaba ñulluꞌn raꞌ ba, ya guzoꞌbaloh cagateꞌta raꞌ ba canua chi loh ñihsa, ya cayuhnn raꞌ ba zigazi nin guzaguꞌhla dxiꞌba gandxu nin naa ziga ansuelu loh ñihsa.

Ya chin guhcabwaꞌ Pahblu ziꞌchi guunn raꞌ ba, chiꞌchi guñiꞌ ba loh capitahn xteenn raꞌ suldahdu cun neezaa loh raꞌ suldahdu guñiꞌ Pahblu rahbi ba: ―Sidela laꞌh raꞌ deeꞌ ayi dxiaꞌhan si laꞌn barcu, ayi gaca gutaꞌh tu xquelnabahan tu ―rahbi Pahblu loh raꞌ ba.
Ya chiꞌchi bachyuuꞌga raꞌ suldahdu duꞌh nin naꞌzu laꞌh canua chi tin biaaban llaaꞌn ñihsadoꞌ.
Ya natehrun guñiꞌnee Pahblu laꞌh raꞌ ba tin gahw raꞌ ba, rahbi ba: ―Nnahdxyih naa chiohpa xmahn ayi rahsi tu ayi za rahw tu laasii nuu tu lligaaba xa gudiꞌhi fihn nin cazahca nuꞌh.
Nnah gulgahw tin gaca guzoꞌballaa tu loh ñihsadoꞌ ayiru xi lligaaba guunn tu laasii nin tuhbi dxyichyihca tu ayi ñihchiloh.
Ya chin guluhlla guñiꞌ Pahblu loh raꞌ ba, chiꞌchi gucaꞌha ba tuhbi pahn, chiꞌchi badiꞌhi ba guel zuxchiilli laꞌh Dxiohs nezloh garaa raꞌ ba, chiꞌchi gutaaꞌha ba pahn chi cayahw ba.
Chiꞌchiyi bieꞌgahn, neezaa raꞌ ba gudahw raꞌ ba.
Ya garaa nu naa nu ziga chiohpa gaywaꞌh cun setenta y seis bwiinn.
Ya chin guluhlla gudahw raꞌ ba chiꞌchi bazaꞌhla raꞌ ba buhxa trihgu loh ñihsadoꞌ laasii tin basihsi barcu chi.

Ya chin biaꞌñih zaꞌca, ayi riuꞌnbwaꞌ raꞌ bwiinn raꞌ nin rusazah barcu yuh raꞌ chi, per bwaꞌha raꞌ ba tuhbi guiꞌw nin naa llehcu ñihsadoꞌ, ya bwiꞌhnn raꞌ ba lligaaba sidela chebiiga ru barcu gahxu riꞌchi zibihyin,

niꞌchin bachyuuꞌga raꞌ ba duꞌh raꞌ nin yiꞌbiiduꞌh llaaꞌn raꞌ gaandxu dxiꞌba nin naꞌzu laꞌh barcu, chiꞌchi baxachiza raꞌ ba yahga nin rusazah laꞌh barcu nee cun neezaa bateesa raꞌ ba lahdxi rooꞌ nin rnaꞌzu bwih, guleeza raꞌ ba lahdu hasta nez naa delanta barcu tin ziꞌchi bacaꞌhnaa bwih laꞌh barcu mahziru serca rwaaꞌ ñihsadoꞌ.

Ya gwanee bwih laꞌh barcu chi hasta radxaꞌga chiohpa cwaꞌh ñihsa, ya riꞌchi guzaꞌbiyihca barcu laꞌn yuhlli loh ñihsadoꞌ gahca, ya seguihdu guzaꞌloh cabihyi nez llaaꞌn barcu cun jweersi xteenn ñihsadoꞌ chi.
Ya guclaaꞌdzi raꞌ suldahdu ñachi raꞌ bwiinn prehsu tin ayi guzoꞌballaa raꞌ ba ñihsa gulluꞌn raꞌ ba.

Per ayi guziꞌguehlda capitahn ñuhnn raꞌ suldahdu ziꞌchi laasii ayi xclaaꞌdzi capitahn chi gachi Pahblu mejor gunabwaꞌ ba galoh raꞌ nin rahca ruzoꞌballaa ñihsa guichiehsa loh ñihsadoꞌ tin gadzihn raꞌ ba loh yuh bihdzi,

chiꞌchi bariaꞌh raꞌ bwiinn nin ayi nuu guzoꞌballaa ñihsa, chiꞌchi ziaganaꞌhla raꞌ ba laꞌh raꞌ ba cun loh tahblu raꞌ o tuhbi taaꞌha yahga nin gubihyi barcu, ya ziꞌchizi guyaꞌloh bariaꞌcaa raꞌ ba loh yuh bihdzi.
